name: Cyber Fox
sire: By CYBER ATTACK SI 101 (2020). Champion, 7 wins, $1,721,346, Los Alamitos Two Million Fut. [G1], Ruidoso Derby [G1], 2nd Golden State Million Fut. [G1], Rainbow Fut. [G1], Rainbow Derby [G1]. Brother to ENFORCE SI 95 (Champion), POWERFUL FAVORITE SI 106, RUNFORYOURLIFE SI 96, BOMB CYCLONE SI 104; half brother to TESSTA ROSSA SI 99, INTENSE FIRE SI 97, MAJORITY INTEREST SI 95. His first foals are yearlings of 2026. Son of stakes winner, FAVORITE CARTEL SI 104; sire of 149 stakes winners, 8 champions.
